3.problem:
\(ABCDEFGH\) is an octagon whose eight interior angles all have the same measure. The lengths of the eight sides of this octagon are, in some order, \[2, 2\sqrt{2}, 4, 4\sqrt{2}, 6, 7, 7, \text{ and } 8.\]

Find the area of \(ABCDEFGH\).
